title: Power Satellites & Space Based Solar Power
summary: Isaac Arthur explores space-based solar power, in which satellites beam energy down via microwaves to rectennas on Earth. He discusses feasibility, profitability and its role in spurring space colonization.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the best overview of power satellites, with pros and cons beyond the construction cost.

quote.text: Issac Arthur usually has the best overview of topics like this
